# Toolzy

> Toolzy is a free, browser-based developer toolbox with 28 tools. All tools run entirely client-side using the Web Crypto API and local JavaScript. No data, files, or keys are ever uploaded to any server. See also: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/ai.txt

## JSON and Data Tools

- [JSON Formatter](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/json/): Format, validate, minify, and explore JSON in the browser with tree view, schema generation, TypeScript type generation, and shareable links.
- [JSON Transformer](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/json-transform/): Filter and transform JSON using jq-compatible expressions (map, select, sort_by, group_by, to_entries, reduce) in the browser.
- [CSV Tool](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/csv/): Parse, preview, filter, sort, and export CSV and TSV data in the browser with column statistics and JSON export.
- [YAML / JSON / TOML Converter](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/yaml/): Convert between YAML, JSON, and TOML configuration formats with live conversion and download.
- [SQL Formatter](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/sql/): Format, beautify, and minify SQL queries across 15 dialects (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, BigQuery, Snowflake, and more) in the browser.

## Encoding and Cryptography

- [Encoding Hub](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/encode/): Encode and decode text and files using Base64, URL-safe Base64, percent-encoding, Data URLs, and query-string parsing.
- [JWT Hub](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/jwt/): Decode, encode, and verify JSON Web Tokens (HS256, RS256, ES256) with security scoring and server-side code examples.
- [Crypto Suite](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/crypto/): Generate SHA-1 / SHA-256 / SHA-384 / SHA-512 hashes, HMAC signatures, UUID v1-v5, and random secrets using the Web Crypto API.
- [Password Generator](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/password/): Generate strong random passwords and BIP39-style passphrases in the browser using the Web Crypto API.

## Developer Utilities

- [curl to Code Converter](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/curl/): Convert curl commands to Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, PHP, and Ruby code in the browser.
- [Number Base Converter](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/number-base/): Convert integers between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal with arbitrary precision and bitwise operations.
- [chmod Calculator](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/chmod/): Calculate Unix file permissions interactively with checkbox toggles, octal input, and common presets.
- [Cron Expression Builder](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/cron/): Build and decode cron expressions visually with plain-English descriptions, next-run previews, and AWS EventBridge / GitHub Actions output.
- [Fake Data Generator](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/fake-data/): Generate realistic, reproducible fake data using Faker v10 JSON templates across 50 locales, with CSV, SQL, and NDJSON export.
- [Environment File Generator](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/env/): Build, parse, and convert .env files in the browser with framework templates and automatic secret scrubbing for .env.example.
- [HTTP Status Codes](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/http-status/): Browse and search all HTTP 1xx to 5xx status codes with descriptions and RFC links.

## Text and Writing

- [Text Utilities](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/text/): Convert text case (camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, PascalCase), slugify, sort lines, deduplicate, and count words and bytes.
- [Text and Code Diff](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/text-diff/): Compare two texts or code snippets with line-by-line Myers diff in side-by-side and unified views, with .patch download.
- [Markdown Editor](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/markdown/): Browser-only CodeMirror Markdown editor with live GitHub-Flavored Markdown preview, local autosave, and HTML export.
- [HTML Editor](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/html-editor/): Visual WYSIWYG HTML editor built on Tiptap with sanitized import, rich formatting, table support, and HTML source output.

## Design and Visualization

- [Color Converter](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/color/): Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, CMYK, generate palettes, check WCAG contrast, and extract colors from images.
- [Regex Playground](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/regex/): Test regular expressions live with match highlighting, capture groups, replace mode, and a library of common patterns.

## Time and Scheduling

- [Date and Time Toolkit](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/datetime/): Convert Unix timestamps, compare 400 IANA timezones, calculate date differences, and build cron expressions.

## Privacy and Security

- [Image Metadata Viewer](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/image-metadata/): Inspect and remove EXIF, GPS, IPTC, and XMP metadata from JPEG and PNG files locally without re-encoding.
- [Document Signer](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/document-signer/): Sign and verify files locally using RSA-PSS and ECDSA via the Web Crypto API, with OpenSSL-compatible detached signatures.
- [Certificate Inspector](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/certificate/): Decode X.509 certificates and PKCS#10 CSRs locally, showing subject, issuer, SANs, key usage, and fingerprints.

## Comparison and Diffing

- [API Diff](https://devtools.rusiru.cc/diff/): Compare two API responses or data payloads and see structural differences in JSON, XML, HTML, and plain text with ignore rules.
